rss_note: psutil.memory_info().rss measures CPU-side process RSS only. On Apple Silicon (unified memory), model weights are allocated via Metal/MPS and not reflected in psutil RSS. sampled_peak_rss_mb is the maximum RSS sampled at ~100ms intervals during load + warmup; spikes shorter than 100ms can be missed. MPS fields (mps_allocated_mb_*) reflect GPU-resident weight bytes via torch.mps.current_allocated_memory() and are the correct capacity planning signal on this machine. Swapouts in vm_stat parsed_counters is a monotonic cumulative counter since boot, not a current snapshot.
